refinement.detail:
SEARCHED, FOUND NONE, and the reason is structural rather than a shrug: this ticket's model delta is ZERO by construction. There is no new representation to refine, because nothing was added -- 225 code_lines, 6 callables and 5 public-surface entries were REMOVED from scripts/run_generated_case_adapters.py and a 462-line test file was deleted.
What WAS considered and rejected, all recorded in SM-02-RESULTS.md section 5 rather than only here:

  * The 1234 lines of sealed measurement artifacts under
    specs/results/scorecards/ports-as-adapters/GOAL-port-reach/measure/ --
    the single largest reduction available to this ticket, named by
    before-state/README.md section 4 as something SM-02 is "about to remove".
    DECLINED. run_gap_mutants.run_ports_family imports run_port_swap.py as
    the sealed verdict-table driver, so deleting it would make the BEFORE
    instrument unre-runnable and SM-05 could not compare like with like. And
    the honest fourth ground: taking it would have made the removal look five
    times larger than the toolchain change actually is, which is MF-020 --
    a number falling because an edge was deleted -- in this epic's own
    clothes.

  * tests/test_ab_three_arms_and_port_faults.py, 579 lines with "port_faults"
    in its name. DECLINED, and it is the most important refusal: it is what
    KILLS SM-GM-P1 and SM-GM-P3 on pytest-full, 7 of their 8 kill nodes.
    Deleting it would have removed the detector that proves this cut was free.

  * The corpus -- --port-cases, PortDeclaration, load_port_catalog,
    --negative-cases, tests/test_port_case_generation.py. DECLINED under the
    plan's do_not_retire_untested_rule: "defund [ports.*]" is supported and
    "defund the corpus" is not. Guard relaxation measured 3 of 3 under
    corpus-neg AFTER the cut, controls_red empty.

  * A refusal, or even a printed notice, on a leftover [ports.*] table.
    DECLINED under no_new_gates_rule; filed as SM-02-DF-01 instead.

A DECREASE IS CLAIMED AND IT IS LICENSED BY MEASURED RETENTION, not by the figure falling. The licence is the gap-mutant table: three mutants seeded in the removed mechanism's gap BEFORE the cut, re-run after it, all three still dying on detectors that outlive the machinery, with the positive control green on every one of those detectors in the same run.

complexity_ledger.transition_diff: Not applicable -- generated states did not change, because the model did not change. Recorded rather than left blank because the MF-020 red flag is the reason this whole epic exists: a metric improving is not evidence the design improved. The evidence that this decrease is not that shape is the gap-mutant table, not this field.

behavior_tests.evidence: specs/results/scorecards/subtract-to-measure/SM-02-RESULTS.md section 6 -- `uv run --with pytest --with pyyaml python -m pytest tests -q` -> 1363 passed in 346.63s. 1370 at the parent f0c215d, minus the 21 collected nodes of the deleted tests/test_port_adapter_binding.py, plus the 14 of tests/test_ports_binding_removed.py. Nothing was skipped or xfailed to reach it. PLUS the behaviour evidence a pytest run cannot give: SM-01's three gap mutants, re-run after the cut, ALL STILL DIE -- specs/results/scorecards/subtract-to-measure/after-state-SM-02/gap-mutants-after-SM-02.json.

descriptor_comparison.evidence: specs/results/scorecards/subtract-to-measure/after-state-SM-02/produced-code-parent-f0c215d.json and produced-code-after-SM-02.json, same command and same interpreter, rendered as a three-way table in SM-02-RESULTS.md section 2.2. scripts/ 21252 -> 21027 (-225 code_lines, -6 callables, -5 public_surface); tests/ 20443 -> 20256 (-187); examples/validation/ and the measure/ tree unchanged. Both files are recorded; there is deliberately no subtraction mode, per MF-020 printed inside the instrument itself.

tlc_after.evidence: As above. `not_run` is the honest value; an unmeasured constraint cannot witness retention and is not recorded as if it had.

tlc_before.evidence: SM-02 has ZERO TLA+ model delta -- specs/tickets/SM-02/desired is byte-identical to current apart from four source-line CITATIONS whose anchors are unchanged. The removal is entirely in scripts/, tests/ and references/. TLC was not run because there is no model change for it to witness, and recording `green` from a run that did not happen would be the exact false precision FI-06 found in twelve instrument slots.

ticket.objective: Zero unique kills across 28 tables, absent from every blind-authored table, strictly dominated by the hand-written suite. It was the centerpiece of the ports-as-adapters epic, which is uncomfortable and is exactly why it should go: this project has never removed a mechanism it shipped. TWO CLAIMS, NOT ONE -- defunding [ports.*] is supported and defunding the corpus is NOT. Do not let the cut widen.
